capabilities: Manage clients, suppliers, inventory and debts
Record income and expense transactions with filters and recurrence
Track multi-currency exchange rates from APIs
Show a dashboard with KPIs, charts and stock alerts
Export clients, suppliers and transactions to CSV
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a tool for managing orders or queues; it is small-business bookkeeping stored in Markdown notes.
extras: README is bilingual (Spanish/English); community-plugin listing described as upcoming, so installation currently requires manual GitHub download. Exchange-rate updates fetch from external APIs. All data is stored as .md notes with YAML frontmatter.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in bookkeeping tools, so tracking business finances, stock and debts inside a vault requires external software.
summary: Accounting plugin that manages clients, suppliers, inventory, transactions and debts in multiple currencies and accounting books.
